t: This is the statue of Field Marshal Harold Alexander, 1st Earl Alexander of Tunis. It stands in the grounds of Wellington Barracks, beside the Flanders Fields Memorial Garden and the Guards Chapel. Alexander was born in London and educated at Harrow and Sandhurst, and he was commissioned into the Irish Guards. He served in both world wars. The sculptor is James Butler, who is most famous for his 1980 statue of Richard III in Leicester.
